summary: WFH (Work From Home) Feature fully tested. Backend: 14/14 API tests passed (100%). Frontend: All WFH UI features working - WFH tab, Apply WFH dialog, Pending Approvals with WFH section, Approve/Reject/Cancel flows verified.
passed_tests: Backend: POST /api/wfh/apply returns wfh_id starting with 'WFH-', status=pending, correct dates
Backend: POST /api/wfh/apply validates required fields (returns 400/422 for missing from_date)
Backend: GET /api/wfh/my-requests returns user's WFH requests with all required fields
Backend: GET /api/wfh/my-requests supports status filter query param
Backend: GET /api/wfh/pending-approvals returns pending WFH requests with employee info
Backend: PUT /api/wfh/{wfh_id}/approve returns success message
Backend: PUT /api/wfh/{wfh_id}/approve returns 404 for non-existent request
Backend: PUT /api/wfh/{wfh_id}/reject with rejection_reason query param returns success
Backend: PUT /api/wfh/{wfh_id}/cancel returns success for own pending request
Backend: PUT /api/wfh/{wfh_id}/cancel returns 404 for non-existent request
Backend: WFH days calculation is correct (3 days for Apr 6-8)
Backend: Approved WFH status persists in my-requests
Backend: Unauthorized access to /api/wfh/my-requests returns 401
Backend: Unauthorized access to /api/wfh/apply returns 401
Frontend: Login as admin (admin@shardahr.com/password) works
Frontend: 'Work From Home' tab visible in Leave page tabs with badge count
Frontend: WFH tab shows WFH Requests table with columns (FROM, TO, DAYS, REASON, STATUS, APPLIED ON)
Frontend: WFH requests display correct statuses (approved, pending, cancelled, rejected)
Frontend: 'Apply WFH' button present and opens dialog
Frontend: Apply WFH dialog has From Date, To Date (Calendar pickers), and Reason fields
Frontend: Apply WFH dialog has Cancel and 'Submit WFH Request' buttons
Frontend: Pending Approvals tab shows WFH Requests section with blue background
Frontend: WFH entries in Pending Approvals show 'Work From Home' label in blue
Frontend: WFH approval button works - shows 'WFH approved successfully' toast
Frontend: Two-step approval labels visible (Manager: pending, HR: pending)
critical_code_review_comments: WFH endpoints properly implemented in server.py (lines 3118-3413)
WFH requests stored in 'wfh_requests' MongoDB collection
Two-step approval flow implemented: manager first (dept_head_status), then HR (hr_status)
When WFH is fully approved, attendance auto-marked as 'wfh' for the approved date range
Notifications sent to managers/HR when WFH is applied, and to employee on approval/rejection
LeavePage.js properly integrates WFH tab with state management for wfhRequests and wfhApprovals
WFH approvals displayed in Pending Approvals tab with blue styling to differentiate from leaves
